turns.text: Life rarely goes according to our original plans, and that's not necessarily a bad thing.
turns.zh: 人生很少会按照我们最初的计划走，但这未必是坏事。

turns.text: The important thing is to maintain forward momentum and stay open to new opportunities when they come your way.
turns.zh: 重要的是保持向前的劲头，机会来的时候要敞开心扉去接住。

turns.text: That makes me feel so much better.
turns.zh: 听你这么说，我心里好受多了。

turns.text: I've been really worried that I'm falling behind or making huge mistakes by not having everything figured out already.
turns.zh: 我一直特别担心自己落后了，或者因为还没把一切想清楚就犯了大错。

turns.text: Very few individuals have their entire lives mapped out at that age, no matter how confident they might appear on social media.
turns.zh: 那个年纪的人，极少有谁把一辈子都规划好了的，不管他们在社交媒体上看起来多自信。

turns.text: You're being thoughtful and responsible, and that matters way more than having all the answers right now.
turns.zh: 你是在认真思考、负责任地对待这件事，这比现在就什么都懂重要多了。
